{"content": "1|def transform(grid):
2|    """Extend pairs of same-color markers along rows/columns of an 8-grid."""
3|    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
4|    row_bars = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 8 for v in grid[r])]
5|    col_bars = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h))]
6|
7|    def bands(size, bars):
8|        starts = [0] + [b + 1 for b in bars]
9|        ends = bars + [size]
10|        spans = [(s, e) for s, e in zip(starts, ends) if e > s]
11|        # A final incomplete margin beyond the last full cell is not a grid cell.
12|        lengths = [e - s for s, e in spans]
13|        full = max(set(lengths), key=lengths.count)
14|        return [(s, e) for s, e in spans if e - s == full]
15|
16|    rb = bands(h, row_bars)
17|    cb = bands(w, col_bars)
18|    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
19|    markers = {}
20|    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(rb):
21|        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(cb):
22|            colors = {grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8)}
23|            for color in colors:
24|                markers.setdefault(color, []).append((ri, ci))
25|
26|    paint = {}
27|    for color, points in markers.items():
28|        if len(points) < 2:
29|            continue
30|        # Each pair defines a straight segment in cell coordinates.
31|        for i in range(len(points)):
32|            for j in range(i + 1, len(points)):
33|                r0, c0 = points[i]
34|                r1, c1 = points[j]
35|                if r0 == r1:
36|                    cells = [(r0, c) for c in range(min(c0, c1), max(c0, c1) + 1)]
37|                elif c0 == c1:
38|                    cells = [(r, c0) for r in range(min(r0, r1), max(r0, r1) + 1)]
39|                else:
40|                    continue
41|                for cell in cells:
42|                    paint.setdefault(cell, set()).add(color)
43|
44|    for (ri, ci), colors in paint.items():
45|        color = 6 if 2 in colors and 3 in colors else min(colors)
46|        r0, r1 = rb[ri]
47|        c0, c1 = cb[ci]
48|        for r in range(r0, r1):
